items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: I heard Bessie in person, yeah. I heard Bessie Smith in person.

ctx.x: Well what about Bessie Smith and Mamie Smith and Trixie Smith and all those women, they all had Smith names, you know?

Well Bessie Smith, Bessie, I know her and she was a blues singer too. But all them other Smiths I don't know nothing about them. I have heard several of them but I don't know too much about them, you know?
But Bessie you heard definitely, ma'am.
